# Agent stages (fixture)

| Stage | Prompt | Gate before it starts |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Inventory | stage 1 | Scope agreed |
| 2 Target model | stage 2 | Stage 1 confirmed |
| 3 Gap | stage 3 | Stage 2 confirmed |
| 4 Findings | stage 4 | Stage 3 gap confirmed: a sample of "live" signals and each "proven" detection checked by a person through another path than the agent's query |
| 5 Maturity | stage 5 | Stage 4 confirmed: every draft re-checked and its verdict recorded or sent in the verdict batch; a finding still waiting stays *assumption*, and a level resting on it is provisional |
| 6 Recommendations | stage 6 | Stage 5 confirmed; findings still *assumption* go into the confirmation batch first |
